Name: Kedi's Pets Furniture
Author: KeDili
Description:
[size=3]This is a mod that adds various furniture and toys for your pets, they deserve being petted and all of course, but what about the play and decor?

[b]The mod requires 2 frameworks:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Dynamic Game Assets (Required for the 1.5 version) ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365[/url] )[/size]
[*][size=3]Content Patcher (Required for the 1.6 version) ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]﻿ )[/size]
[*][size=3]Alternative Textures ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246[/url] )[/size]
[/list][size=3]After installing those and all of their requirements, just unzip and drop the mod to your Mods folder, and give your pet the love and toys that it needs!

All of the furniture can be found at Robin’s shop.

If you find a bug, please go to [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] , upload your log by reading the instructions on that website, and send a bug report to me with the link it’ll give you! (Also attach a visual item (Image/Video) if its a visual issue. I’m also open to suggestions!)

[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/108727003?tab=user+files][size=3]Check out my other mods![/size][/url][url=https://artistree.io/kedidili][size=3]
[/size][/url]
